edits.old: Then no partial set of measures is shown and 2026-12-15 has no value
edits.new:
Then no partial set of measures is shown and 2026-12-15 has no value

  Scenario: AC12 Error answers (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a caller sends no credentials
    When the caller sends GET /reports/measures?from=2026-12-15&to=2026-12-15
    Then the response is status 401
    Given a caller asks for a report id the service does not hold
    When the caller sends GET /reports/{id}
    Then the response is status 404

  Scenario: AC13 Activity retry and timeout (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rwb-case contract mock times out on its first call for the 2026-12-15 cut-off
    When the steering measure refresh runs at 01:30 on 2026-12-16
    Then the retry count and the timeout are Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-S8-E2009-APP-AC13)
    Then the run writes one provenance entry for 2026-12-15 with its verdict

  Scenario: AC14 Consumed call fails (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rwb-decision contract mock returns a failure for the 2026-12-15 read
    When the steering measure refresh runs at 01:30 on 2026-12-16
    Then GET /reports/measures?from=2026-12-15&to=2026-12-15 returns status 503 with MSG-GEN-006 naming "rwb-decision"
    Then no partial set of measures is shown and 2026-12-15 has no value

  Scenario: AC15 Disallowed status change (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given day 2026-12-15 is held under AC4
    When the steering measure refresh runs again for business date 2026-12-15 and the counts still differ
    Then the day stays held and no published verdict is returned for it
    Then the refusal message is Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-S8-E2009-APP-AC15)
